name: Tokugawa Yoshinobu
summary: Yoshinobu sought to preserve Tokugawa authority through military modernization and accommodation with the imperial court. He promoted foreign contact while retaining hereditary political authority and restricted religious toleration.

sources.title: Return of governing authority memorial, November 9, 1867 (document155-B)
sources.author: Tokugawa Yoshinobu, translated in The Documents of Iriki / University of Tokyo
sources.usedFor: His own argument for unified imperial authority and consultation of lords.
